subject.title: [Feature]: Channels settings page should always show built-in channels alongside custom channels

question: Should maintainers review/adopt the open fork PR for this issue, or close it and request a fresh same-repository replacement?
rationale: The source-level bug remains, but an open fork PR already contains the focused resolver/test change and blocks a new automated repair lane.

options.title: Review or adopt the fork PR
options.body: Use the existing focused patch if maintainers can refresh proof and resolve the stale failing check state.

options.title: Replace with a same-repository PR
options.body: Close the fork PR and ask for or author a fresh UI-only resolver fix with current Control UI proof.

recommendation.title: Review or adopt the fork PR
recommendation.body: Use the existing focused patch if maintainers can refresh proof and resolve the stale failing check state.

likelyOwner.reason: Most directly tied to the metadata-driven channel UI resolver and gateway catalog refactor that shapes this bug.
